summary: `agent mission create --pr-bound --json` fails BRANCH_STRATEGY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED unless `--branch-strategy already-confirmed` is passed; the flag is cut off the first page of --help.
suggested_fix: Surface the required flag earlier in --help; the remediation message was already clear.

summary: AcceptanceSummary.ok reads activity_issues only and never skipped/blocked_checks, so recording a missing lanes.json as a skipped check alone left ok=True. This is the load-bearing mechanism behind P0 #4891.
root_cause: `ok` predicate ignores blocked/skipped diagnostics; absent-lanes branch appended no activity_issue
suggested_fix: Mirror the CorruptLanesError arm and append an activity_issue.

summary: An existing characterization test, test_missing_lanes_manifest_is_a_silent_noop, encoded the bug as expected behaviour and had to be inverted as the red-first anchor.
root_cause: Characterization test pinned the defective no-op behaviour
suggested_fix: Invert codifying tests as the red anchor.

summary: A coord-aware lanes.json read was rejected. lanes.json is a PRIMARY-partition artifact (mission_runtime/artifacts.py), so a coord read would create partition confusion and a second authority.
merge does not independently re-verify acceptance state, so accept is the only chokepoint. Defense-in-depth in merge was deliberately not implemented and not ticketed; it lives only in the PR body.
suggested_fix: Future architecture: merge asserts mission acceptance state before landing.

summary: In the reachable 3.2.0-era upgraded coord-mission shape, the coord copy of lanes.json is legacy residue and the primary copy is genuinely absent. Recovery depends on the operator running finalize-tasks.
The tooling-friction tracer holds one planning-time observation and an unfilled '(append during implement/review)' placeholder.
Lane worktrees have no dedicated .venv, so every test run needs `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src <repo-root>/.venv/bin/python -m pytest`.
root_cause: Worktrees are not provisioned with a venv

summary: 46 tests/upgrade failures are environment false reds. The preview_support fixtures shell out to `<worktree>/.venv/bin/spec-kitty`, which does not exist in a lane worktree.
root_cause: Fixture requires an installed-in-checkout spec-kitty binary
suggested_fix: Resolve the binary from the active interpreter rather than the checkout path.

summary: `make test-fast` shells out to `uv run --frozen`, which is disallowed in a worktree because it re-syncs the hand-built venv. The target's dirs, markers and flags had to be replayed by hand.
suggested_fix: Provide a make target or variable that runs the fast tier against an explicit interpreter without uv sync.

summary: 3 test_charter_json_error_contract.py tests always fail when the suite runs inside a linked worktree. The charter-write linked-worktree refusal fires in the tests themselves.
root_cause: Charter write guard (fail-closed from linked worktree) is not isolated from the test environment

summary: A single-file mypy run reports `no-any-return` false positives because of `follow_imports=skip` for specify_cli.* in pyproject. Only checking the file together with its dependency is clean.
root_cause: mypy follow_imports=skip resolves ProjectMetadata types as Any

summary: The fix belongs at the single per-worktree timestamp mint site in runner.py, which has three callers. A CLI-wrapper-only fix would miss two of them.
root_cause: last_upgraded_at minted with now_utc() whenever version!=target, even on bookkeeping-only bumps

summary: The spec originally cited the wrong prior-art gate (#1872 migration-record suppression, not the #1838 save-gate).
lanes/merge.py and lanes/stale_check.py still refuse a lane as stale on a .kittify/metadata.yaml conflict. The operator chose prevention only, so the consumers were left unchanged.
The companion no-op-repeat test passed vacuously before the fix because it never asserts alignment. Only the primary assertion was a real red anchor.

`agent decision open` failed MISSION_NOT_FOUND although meta.json existed on primary: decisions/service.py resolves through the status-only coord husk. The bug under repair blocked the mission's own decision path.
root_cause: Coord-materialised mission resolves meta.json via the coord worktree that lacks it (#4966)
suggested_fix: Workaround used: decision recorded inline in research.md

summary: Known friction from the issue-matrix per-WP approval gate and review-cycle-artifact commits was carried in.
tracer-append swallowed an unmaterialised-coord read into an empty string, which the writer then turned into a fresh header. The result clobbered a populated traces file.
root_cause: _NO_EXISTING_CONTENT_EXCEPTIONS catches StatusReadPathNotFound (and the new subclass); `current_content or _default_header`
suggested_fix: Seam-level raise in mission_runtime/resolution.py, propagated by readers

summary: The fail-closed locus is seam-level (resolution.py raises) rather than per-reader, which closes the class. Auditing every seam caller becomes the load-bearing planning task.
surface_resolver._coord_branch_exists and `doctor coordination --fix` (#4979) were explicitly left out of scope as adjacent unresolved surfaces.
The review-cycle-1 record is a bare 'Approved by claude: approval:WP02' with an empty affected_files list, so the review evidence is thin.
All three tracers stop at '(planning) seeded' with no implement-phase entries.

`spec-kitty plan --json` scaffolded plan.md from a stale template: retired src/doctrine path and 'Constitution Check' in place of 'Charter Check'. The author rewrote it against the canonical packs/built-in template.
root_cause: Stale git-tracked project override .kittify/overrides/missions/software-dev/templates/plan-template.md wins resolution (diagnosed in interpreter-matrix mission; SK-248)
suggested_fix: Re-sync or delete the stale override

summary: The WP08 dispatch said lanes were not merged, but the lane-dependency mechanism had already merged all six code lanes into the shared lane-planning workspace. The prescribed manual `git apply` failed for every lane.
suggested_fix: Final-integration dispatches should scope 'not merged' to the mission-level merge and expect dependency lanes to be merged into the planning workspace.

summary: SK-250: move-task and mark-status leave status files dirty after their own auto-commit, which forces residual cleanup commits.
The recurring #4017-class 'Global asset input changed' race is listed as a friction class other WPs in the mission hit.
The issue-matrix gate blocks every WP approval until every row has a verdict.
A rejection resets all subtasks, which then have to be re-marked (seen in WP04 and WP06 cycle-1).
SK-248: .kittify/overrides shadows the plan template.
SK-251: test_marker_registry_single_source.py carries stale references.
Known baseline reds recur in the integration worktree: 3 linked-worktree charter-write failures plus 6 pre-existing tests/specify_cli/cli failures.
The ruff-format-exclude ratchet goes red once a WP incidentally formats an excluded file (__init__.py). pyproject.toml was not WP-owned, so the mission's own PR carries a red gate.
root_cause: Shrink-only exclude ratchet plus owned_files boundaries that exclude pyproject.toml
suggested_fix: Assign pyproject.toml exclude edits to the WP that reformats the file.

summary: finalize-tasks returned LANE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE because all planning_artifact WPs collapse into one lane-planning node, and WP01 upstream plus WP08 downstream of the code lanes forms a cycle.
root_cause: PLANNING_LANE_ID bundles every planning_artifact WP regardless of graph position (lanes/compute.py)
suggested_fix: Removed hard WP01 edges and kept ordering in prose

summary: The golden path passed at 102.56s against the hard 110s bar, leaving only 7.44s of margin. Setup cost is dominated by the session-scoped test_venv `pip install -e`, which no lever in the mission touched.
root_cause: test_venv one-time editable install dominates CI setup phase
suggested_fix: Address test_venv install cost in a follow-up.

summary: Profiling found that ensure_global_agent_commands renders 13 agents x 8 commands (104 templates) on every CLI invocation with no freshness pre-check, about 55-65% of per-call cost. The '#4213 hang' was a budget overrun, not a hang.
root_cause: Unconditional render in assess_global_agent_commands on every main_callback
suggested_fix: Freshness-stamp pre-check plus destination-health check; lazy command imports

summary: Spec review ran six fresh-sweep rounds with two HALTs and five operator rulings, mostly over wording, attribution style and line-range precision rather than substance.
suggested_fix: Calibrate squad-round caps and severity thresholds for spec-text nits.

summary: Phase agents twice resolved genuine decision forks unilaterally (SPEC-VERIFY-003 inference; PLAN-GOV-001 lever substitution). Both were caught by review and needed operator rulings 3 and 6.
suggested_fix: Phase agents must escalate any deviation from verbatim operator-quoted mechanisms instead of inferring latitude.

summary: Phase-agent fixes regressed on citation accuracy: a wrong decorator line range, the wrong exception type and raise site (PLAN-FRESH-001), and a research.md that was never updated to match plan.md.
suggested_fix: Re-verify every cited line and path against source in each pass; mirror corrections across all artifacts.

summary: The `tests (e2e)` shard runs only for tests/e2e/** or tests/cross_cutting/** paths, so an ordinary CLI-source push never runs the golden-path budget test.
suggested_fix: Rely on the fast-tier structural startup guard (FR-005) for CLI regressions.

summary: markdownlint and commit-msg are effectively non-blocking in live CI (`|| true`).
The tasks-phase PR-size estimate of 450-810 lines landed at 2,000/-127 lines, mostly new test files.
Two low-severity spec wording defects (PLAN-FRESH3-001/002) were deferred unfixed.
`charter context --action specify --json` reported unresolved configured directive IDs while still returning the charter.
Team Kitty publication was unavailable because the local session was logged out. Local mission state stayed authoritative.
The specify-to-plan `spec-kitty next` handoff exceeded the command wait window after opening the plan operation. Lifecycle state had to be recovered without blindly re-running.
'Fast-forwarded' may print only after the coordination ref is re-read and equals the target SHA: success is a postcondition, not an assumption.
The fix reused _coord_worktree_head_finding as the single branch-identity authority instead of duplicating symbolic-ref parsing.
The upstream remote is named `skupstream`, not `upstream`, so the workflow's `git fetch upstream` fails.
The defects are Windows-only but Linux CI is the test host. Faithful mocking (is_windows seam plus simulated follow_symlinks rejection) is the main risk of tests passing for the wrong reason.
suggested_fix: Require the repro to raise on follow_symlinks=False; forbid reusing _simulate_windows_dir_modes.

summary: record-analysis fails DIRTY_WORKTREE on pre-existing untracked files (.kittify/evidence, kitty-ops/*.jsonl). Most kitty-ops files are tracked, so a blanket mv mass-deletes tracked files.
suggested_fix: Move aside only the specific untracked paths.

summary: installer.py imports no-follow helpers through the re-export shim specify_cli/core/no_follow.py, so new helpers must be added to the shim's imports and __all__.
#4925 was deferred as untraced; it needs a real Windows run.

The post-spec adversarial squad found that the #4927 fix targets were wrong (operations._action, projection._stage_effect), found a missed crash site (:172), and flagged a divergence-helper collision.
The new call-site gate reuses the shrink-only pattern from test_os_detection_ban.py and _os_detection_scan.py.
Symlink fidelity on Windows was narrowed to 'must not raise'; fidelity is out of scope.
The auto-mode classifier blocked `git push origin main` when combined in one command, so origin/main alignment was deferred.

safe_commit's `git stash push --staged` / `pop --index` dance fails deterministically on partially staged files. It was replaced by `git commit --only -- <paths>`, which never touches unrelated staged content.
root_cause: Whole-index stash round-trip to hide operator's unrelated staged content
suggested_fix: git commit --only with path-scoped patch snapshot for failure restore

summary: safe_commit no longer calls the whole-index backstop assert_staging_area_matches_expected, because it is incompatible with leaving unrelated staged content in place.
upgrade autocommit flattened SafeCommitRecoveryFailed into a skip warning, and the no-migrations render path ignored result.errors. Both were silent successes and now exit non-zero.
root_cause: except Exception flattening a typed recovery failure

summary: _remove_project_agent_surface reported 'Removed' even when it preserved content: rmdir raised OSError(non-empty), which was caught and still reported as Removed.
root_cause: Return value not verdict-driven
suggested_fix: Route through guard_destructive_removal and render from verdict.owned/diagnostic

summary: Two backup-naming authorities coexisted (template.manager move-based and asset_preservation copy-based). A shared backup_before_overwrite was added.
Widening the mutation-ownership census needs three synchronized edits, because the pinned _ROUTED_MODULES test asserts set equality.
The tooling-friction tracer holds a single entry for a seven-issue mission.
SK-64: the 'Add scaffold for feature ...' commit auto-generated by mission create is not covered by the commitlint ignore regex, and type-enum lacks tasks/analyze.
root_cause: commitlint ignore regex requires meta|spec|tasks|plan as second word
suggested_fix: Run `npx --no-install commitlint --from main --to HEAD` pre-PR; use docs/chore types; fix scaffold commit message or ignore regex.

summary: SK-94: a bare `uv sync` installs neither the test nor the lint extra.
suggested_fix: Always state extras explicitly (uv sync --frozen --all-extras).

summary: SK-99: subagents auto-background long commands and strand waiting for notifications. The observed ceiling is about 600s per foreground Bash call regardless of the timeout parameter.
root_cause: Harness caps foreground Bash at ~600s
suggested_fix: Loop bounded waits (tail --pid / kill -0) in-turn; prefer -k/path-scoped subsets.

summary: The plan scaffold was stale because a git-tracked project override (.kittify/overrides/missions/software-dev/templates/plan-template.md, dated 2026-04-17) outranks the canonical built-in template. It was first misdiagnosed as a plan-command defect.
root_cause: Stale never-re-synced OVERRIDE tier template
suggested_fix: Delete or re-sync the override; add a staleness check for overrides.

summary: docs/configuration/linting-cutoff-policy.md says Bandit and pip-audit are blocking, but no workflow wires either of them.
suggested_fix: Fix the doc or wire the gates.

summary: mypy is invoked by no CI workflow and make lint/typecheck never run in CI, although the charter and CLAUDE.md require zero mypy issues.
suggested_fix: Wire mypy into CI or document it as local-only.

summary: SK-237: `agent tasks tasks-packages` does not exist. The dispatch conflated mission-step IDs with CLI verbs, and finalize lives under `agent mission`.
suggested_fix: Verify --help before first use; fix doctrine that names nonexistent verbs.

summary: build_wp_manifests drops a planning_artifact WP with explicit `owned_files: []` because of a truthiness check, so compute_lanes raises 'Executable WP has no ownership manifest'. Two code paths disagree.
root_cause: `if fm.execution_mode and fm.owned_files:` treats empty list as undeclared (ownership/validation.py:356)
suggested_fix: Honor explicit empty owned_files for planning_artifact WPs; file upstream.

summary: SK-25: a scheduling constraint encoded as `dependencies:` combines with single-lane planning bundling into a false LANE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. This is the second mission to make the same authoring error.
root_cause: Ordering constraint modelled as data dependency + PLANNING_LANE_ID bundling
suggested_fix: Put pure ordering in dispatch sequence and WP prose, never in dependencies:; improve cycle error message.

summary: _detect_dependency_conflicts blocks adding a genuine new dependency edge when the frontmatter already has a different non-empty set. Only narrowing to an empty set passes, so the correct edge could not be landed.
root_cause: Frontmatter-vs-wps.yaml disagreement gate treats manifest additions as conflicts
suggested_fix: Treat wps.yaml as authoritative, or allow any manifest-driven change.

summary: Review verdicts and a tracer wrongly described lanes.json depends_on_lanes as 'merge timing only'. It gates implement-time cross-lane tip merging and the --base honorability guard.
suggested_fix: Do not pass --base for affected WPs; correct the characterization.

summary: A claimed SK-06/#3133 reproduction was a misdiagnosis: the record-analysis input carrier requires the key `schema`, while its output uses schema_version and artifact_type.
root_cause: Input/output key naming collision invites wrong carrier shape
suggested_fix: Document the input carrier contract; consider DX ledger entry.

summary: The baseline run took about 10x longer than estimated (5036s vs 485s) because unrelated agents' pytest runs contended for CPU on the same shared machine.
suggested_fix: Size timeouts generously on shared hosts.

summary: The dir_fd teardown errors also reproduce on Python 3.12, so the 3.12 CI floor was already silently exposed, not only the experimental 3.13 leg.
mark-status has no WP scope, and subtask IDs restart at T001 in every WP. Marking WP02's T001-T003 silently wrote to WP01 and reported false success, and move-task's suggested remedy loops.
root_cause: Subtask ID resolution picks first WP on collision
suggested_fix: Add a --wp scoping flag or refuse ambiguous IDs.

summary: Two tests (test_interview_mapping_mission_alias.py:107, test_docs_index.py:197) run a nested `uv run --frozen` that rebuilds and downgrades the venv mid-run. Pinning UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT is necessary but not sufficient; the fix is --no-sync.
root_cause: Nested unpinned uv run re-syncs to .python-version with no extras
suggested_fix: Use `uv run --frozen --no-sync` in nested test subprocesses; CI pin as containment.

summary: `uv run --no-sync` silently creates an empty venv when UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT points at a missing path. The gap was recorded but not tested.
`ruff format <file>` also reformats pre-existing drift in already format-dirty files, widening the diff with unrelated churn.
suggested_fix: Diff after formatting; revert unrelated hunks.

summary: The dispatch overrode the WP prompt and plan.md, which said to re-sync .venv to 3.13. Following them literally would have destroyed WP01's 3.11 baseline environment.
suggested_fix: Correct planning docs to name a dedicated venv.

summary: Mission docs disagree on the dir_fd failure count (4 vs 5).
_WindowsMandatoryLockSimulator resolves dir_fd-relative paths against cwd. This is safe only at teardown and was flagged for the next person to touch it.
Residual 3.13 divergence was filed on #3189. test_human_output_shows_valid fails only in the full -n auto run and is isolation-sensitive.
A fresh issue was needed for 21 pre-existing 3.11 failures, because #3284 is closed and cannot serve as the open report the charter requires.
ci-nightly.yml triggers only on schedule and workflow_dispatch, so no PR check validates a workflow-file change. Every acceptance scenario has to name a local repro or manual dispatch.
The spec cited a root-level contracts/artefact-naming.md that exists only as a stub inside a prior mission's directory. There is no canonical home for cross-mission CI contracts.
suggested_fix: Establish a stable root-level location for durable cross-mission contracts.

summary: The plan scaffold's 'Constitution Check' and placeholder sections have to be renamed by hand to match the charter's actual section names.
record-analysis wrote the correct verdict across 5 rounds; SK-06/#3133 did not reproduce on 4.0.0rc5.
SK-240: requirement_refs lives in three unsynced places (wps.yaml, WP frontmatter, tasks.md), which cost 3 of 5 analyze fix rounds.
root_cause: Multiple independently writable copies of the same data
suggested_fix: Single write path (generate frontmatter from wps.yaml) or fail-fast disagreement lint.

summary: SK-241: `--mission` is required, but the WP prompt footer and --help examples omit it.

SK-241: the generated implement-prompt footer suggests raw `git commit` where safe-commit is mandatory, and it does not document safe-commit's FILES and --to-branch requirements. The template ships to consumers.
suggested_fix: Update mission-step template footer to the safe-commit form.

summary: SK-241: `agent status emit` has no --wp flag, and for_review->approved is illegal (in_review is required). Neither is documented up front.
radon is missing from .venv although a WP validation step invokes `radon cc`.
suggested_fix: Use ruff C901 or add radon to dev extras.

summary: Lane worktrees ship without a .venv, but WP prompt snippets assume a local .venv/bin/python.
mypy cannot infer the generic `Callable[[], T | None]` for multi-class unions, so a narrow cast() workaround was needed. It may recur for future callers.
The spec's '34 pre-existing failures' in test_aggregate_source.py was a stale-venv false red (ModuleNotFoundError: coverage). Three design phases believed part of their test surface was red.
root_cause: Unsynced local .venv
suggested_fix: Re-sync (uv sync --frozen --all-extras) before recording any ModuleNotFoundError as pre-existing.

summary: SK-64: the scaffold auto-commit tripped commitlint three separate times in one mission (38527f951, 60ea6204f, ec4ceebb8), each needing its own PR-prep fixup.
root_cause: Scaffold commit format recurs per invocation
suggested_fix: Fix at scaffold source.

summary: workflow_run-triggered workflows execute main's copy, so the mission's own PR cannot exercise its fix. Real verification is a post-merge observation window.
The commit-msg job is vacuous (`|| true`), no Bandit/pip-audit job exists, and no workflow references mypy.
plan.md was amended twice on operator authority after passing its review squad, and the squad never re-ran against the amended text.
The planned retry inside reconcile_shards.main() proved vacuous because it re-reads a static local directory. The fix moved to a network poller earlier in the pipeline.
The actual diff (1,041/-74 lines) was about 3x plan.md's PR-size estimate of 250-350 lines; the split decision was escalated to the operator.
C-007 re-confirmed: the ledger still has no entry for the CI-flake defect family itself.
The finalize-tasks requirement-ref regex accepts only FR/NFR/C and not SC-###. A WP citing only Success Criteria is rejected as missing refs with no hint that the prefix is the problem.
root_cause: Hardcoded regex r'\b(?:FR|NFR|C)-\d+\b' in mission_parsing.py
suggested_fix: Accept SC-### or warn on unrecognized prefixes.

summary: A Requirement Refs line wrapped across two physical lines is silently truncated (regex without DOTALL), dropping IDs with no warning.
suggested_fix: Warn on apparently truncated values; keep refs on one line.

summary: A planning_artifact WP placed both upstream and downstream of a code lane caused LANE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE, which was fixed by restructuring the WP decomposition.
root_cause: Single lane-planning node
suggested_fix: Detect the bidirectional planning-lane shape early and suggest the fold.

summary: finalize-tasks wrote a lanes.json for a single_branch mission, with a nonexistent mission_branch and keyword-matched predicted_surfaces unrelated to the mission.
root_cause: Lane computation runs regardless of topology; SURFACE_TAXONOMY matches free-text prose
suggested_fix: Skip lane generation for single_branch; match surfaces on owned_files paths.

summary: Line 4 of the canonical plan-template.md still reads 'Feature specification', violating the Terminology Canon at the template source.
suggested_fix: Fix packs/built-in/missions/software-dev/templates/plan-template.md:4 once.

summary: SK-91/SK-199: `agent action implement` silently created a mission branch and a lane worktree for a single_branch mission. The code commit was stranded on the undeclared lane branch and had to be duplicated on the target branch.
root_cause: Workspace resolver honours stale multi-lane lanes.json over meta.json topology

summary: `agent status emit --help` shows for_review->approved in one step, which is an illegal transition from the only state a reviewed WP is ever in.
suggested_fix: Fix the example; name the legal next hop in the error.

summary: --review-result-json writes `review_result` while the StatusTransitionPayload validator requires `evidence` for approved/done. The Zeitgeist broadcast is dropped on every approval, with a WARNING printed beside 'OK'.
root_cause: Field-name mismatch across the emit/payload seam
suggested_fix: Map review_result onto evidence at the payload boundary, or accept the written field.

summary: The status event stamps execution_mode 'worktree' for a single_branch mission, so the topology divergence reaches the canonical event log.
`make test-fast` and full tests/architectural runs (1261s) auto-background past the Bash timeout. Ending the turn strands the agent, and the coordinator had to intervene.
suggested_fix: Start long runs with run_in_background:true and block in the same turn with `while kill -0 <pid>; do sleep 15; done`.

summary: SK-175: safe-commit accepted and pushed an implementation commit for a WP whose lane was still `planned`. The event log and git disagree, and only a human noticed.
root_cause: safe-commit does not check WP lane state; dispatch skipped `agent action implement`
suggested_fix: Guard commits against unclaimed WPs; dispatches must route through implement.

summary: 'RuntimeError: Global asset input changed: ~/.agent/workflows/...' fires across subcommands as an unenveloped traceback. It is a transient race, likely between concurrent missions regenerating shared global assets, and a retry clears it.
root_cause: Hypothesis: concurrent missions race on shared ~/.agent global asset layer in ensure_global_agent_commands
suggested_fix: Envelope the error; make global asset regeneration concurrency-safe.

summary: mark-status accepts only done/pending, so a correctly skipped conditional subtask can only be recorded falsely as done.
suggested_fix: Add a skipped/not_applicable subtask status accepted as terminal.

summary: Root cause of #4864: the committed duration list had the wrong length, so module-tests silently fell back to uniform weights. Causes were drift, plus a producer/consumer marker mismatch ('not performance' vs 'not performance and not stress').
root_cause: Positional pairing with silent uniform fallback; SELECTION_MARKER_EXPR mismatch (capture_shard_timings.py:76 vs module-tests.yml:210)
suggested_fix: Per-module committed/collected length-agreement gate (added as test_module_length_agreement.py); align marker expressions.

summary: 20 of 21 registry modules still mismatch and are allowlisted. Recapturing the 13 stale modules is out of scope with no follow-up issue, per the no-follow-up rule.
AC4 was not met: the post-fix charter long pole (29m57s) is 2m16s worse than before the fix. The ~2x spread is CI-side variance that local skew cannot see.
WP05's claim that recapture made the skew gate non-vacuous was withdrawn by operator Decision Moment. shard_count is justified by projected CI wall-clock, not skew.
The CLI verdict vocabulary (approved / changes_requested) differs from doctrine (approved / rejected), so 'rejected' is refused on the adverse path.
suggested_fix: Accept 'rejected' as an alias.

summary: `status emit --reason` never reaches status.json notes; only `move-task --note` does, and it requires a real lane transition. add-history also appends after a trailing ### footer.
suggested_fix: Add a note-only annotation command; treat ### headings as section boundaries.

summary: `implement WP07` asks the operator to merge a phantom lane-a into a nonexistent lane-planning ref, and `status emit --to for_review` demands an implementation commit on a lane the topology never creates (SK-69).
root_cause: Implementation-commit guard and dependency-lane auto-merge ignore single_branch topology
suggested_fix: Resolve the guard against the mission's resolved write branch; skip dependency-lane auto-merge for lane-less topologies.

summary: Each move-task call leaves its own trailing identity-annotation event uncommitted. The CLI also labels every caller as actor 'user' (SK-125), which led to false hand-edit accusations.
The WP template assigns PR creation (T037) to the WP agent, while the charter reserves it to the orchestrator, so the lane cannot advance until the PR exists.
suggested_fix: Align WP template with the orchestrator-opens-PR rule.

summary: A dispatch that did not say whether sub-delegation was allowed got sub-delegation: two writers committed to one WP on one branch.
suggested_fix: State sub-delegation permission explicitly in every WP dispatch.

summary: Mutating pre-merge lenses ran concurrently in one checkout, and the tests lens's mutation surfaced as a false failure in the contract lens.
suggested_fix: Serialize tree-mutating lenses or give each its own worktree.

summary: SK-64: commitlint fails on the tool-generated 'Add scaffold for feature ...' commit.
External consumers of the renamed `performance-and-e2e` job name (dashboards, other repos) were not verified.
Two concurrent missions collided in one clone. Planning runs in the root checkout, so HEAD switched mid-specify and a stray commit landed on the other mission's branch.
root_cause: Planning phases run in the repo root checkout, not an isolated worktree
suggested_fix: One clone per concurrent mission; confirm the clone is unoccupied before mission create.

summary: The shell cwd resets between Bash calls, so every command needs a `cd <clone> &&` or `git -C` prefix.
The upstream remote is named `skupstream` in this clone but `upstream` in another.
The global spec-kitty shim (4.0.0rc4, pyenv) differs from the clone's editable .venv, which is a stale-install hazard for code paths that shell out.
Opus implementer subagents died partway through with HTTP 429 session limits, and one WP's partial work was discarded.
suggested_fix: Prefer sonnet implementers or stagger parallel waves; orchestrator watches its own budget.

summary: The claim step auto-commits base_commit metadata into kitty-specs/ on the lane branch, and the review gate then refuses it. The gate's suggested directory-scope `git restore` is unsafe (it deletes issue-matrix.json and acceptance-matrix.json).
root_cause: Implement bootstrap writes planning files on lane branch; remediation text scoped to whole dir
suggested_fix: Scope restore to the single offending WP file; file upstream gap.

summary: Worktrees have no .venv, so tests silently import the main checkout's unfixed editable source unless PYTHONPATH is set.
suggested_fix: Verify import resolution before trusting results.

summary: The shipped specify checklist template in packs/built-in emits the prohibited 'Feature' term.
suggested_fix: File against the template, not by hand-editing consumer artifacts.

summary: Squads found that the deterministic harness could not gate the lock (a spy and call-order assertion were added) and that re-read-inside-lock was not pinned (mutant survives), plus a fail-open-on-lock-timeout gap.
The lock serializes verdict-vs-verdict writes only. Non-verdict acceptance-matrix writers (finalize/accept/gate) remain unserialized.
The #2482 restage-clobber stays unfolded, and the atomic write door for the issue writer was consciously deferred.
A missing issue-matrix would have blocked move-task --to approved, so rows were scaffolded in advance and an auto-discovered #2482 was marked not-applicable.
Self-attested test counts were replaced with 'paste terminal output; reviewer re-runs', and the CHANGELOG close-out became a tracked checklist.
The editable install cannot rebuild because the corporate artifactory index lacks hatchling, so entry-point changes could not be re-registered.
The blast-radius tests live outside make test-fast's directories (tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/agent/, tests/lanes/). Golden-contract and doc-freshness gates go red only in CI.
suggested_fix: List those dirs explicitly in the PR's Tests run.

summary: Adding a CLI flag requires regenerating docs/api/agent-subcommands.md via build_cli_reference.py, or the freshness gate goes red.

The lane-branch hygiene gate refused move-task for_review because the implement bootstrap auto-commit wrote tasks/WP01 and status files onto the lane branch. The coord/primary split makes the lane's kitty-specs diverge from both (field report L1).
root_cause: Implement bootstrap writes kitty-specs on lane branch; lane branched from coord
suggested_fix: Pivot (L2): implement directly on mission branch, cherry-pick -x lane work.

summary: The L2 pivot moved from lane worktrees to sequential single-orchestrator implementation on the mission branch, with the lane-a worktree torn down.
A fifth reader of the recorded planning pin (the detached_base route in _guard_base_honorable) was deliberately left non-orphan-aware.
The #4178 preserve-WARN false positive, which fired on the tool's own bookkeeping commit, was folded together with print-before-write.
The allocator's OrphanedPlanningCommitError next_step for a FOREIGN pin points at a flag that finalize refuses, a two-hop path; this was polished pre-PR.
A fresh coord lane legitimately shares no common ancestor with the primary-partition planning commit, so orphan detection must key off the target-branch tip.
`charter context --action specify` emits CharterCatalogMissWarning noise for java/maven/typescript artifacts filtered out under the python language set.
There is no `agent mission issue-matrix` CLI surface, so issue-matrix.json is authored by hand.
suggested_fix: Add a sanctioned issue-matrix authoring command.

summary: The planning premise was wrong: the charter tier lacks built-in path and artifact data, and legacy and charter artifacts encode different concerns. The mission was re-scoped to a targeted loader, WP04 and WP05 were dropped, and convergence was deferred to #2652.
root_cause: Architect assumed expected_artifacts already carried required+optional without loss

summary: The legacy org-blind specify_cli/mission.py resolver remains. The new path_conventions slot is null for all built-ins, so WP02 added a slot that nothing populates.
The typeless->software-dev template default is preserved; removing it is sequenced later under #2660.
The post-spec squad caught that grounding had lumped two distinct fallbacks under #2660.
The implement-phase notes sections were left as bare '-' placeholders.
Live dogfood: the approval gate demanded verdicts for context-only refs (#2816, #3454, #4330). No truthful verdict existed, forcing a false 'deferred-with-followup'.
root_cause: Over-broad issue-reference discovery + no non-gating verdict value
suggested_fix: Classify references (only implementation targets gate) + add not-applicable verdict.

summary: Issue text drifts from current behaviour: several reported sub-defects were already fixed (#4330) or by design (#2816), so reproduce-before-fix mattered.
The 'is this reference gating?' computation was forked across the approval blocker, merge_gates and status/doctor. It is unified into one exported helper.
Post-tasks squads found that the red-first framing was vacuously green and corrected the anchor line drift.
WP09's not_applicable intent was documented but never implemented in merge_gates.py.
Two dedupe layers keep only the first occurrence and could silently downgrade a dual-cited implementation target.
move-task gained --actor/--reason aliases to match issue-verdict's vocabulary.
The implement-phase sections of the approach and design tracers stay '_(to be filled per WP)_'.
Charter write commands mutate tracked files and worktrees do not isolate charter writes, so repro needed isolated git clones.
The #2627 'Global asset input changed' global-asset-cache race crashed activate --resynthesize and intermittently move-task and merge; a retry self-heals it.
Folding analysis and brownfield findings after finalize-tasks left planning_commit_sha stale, so implement failed to auto-merge the planning commit.
suggested_fix: Fold squad findings before finalize, or expect the re-pin.

summary: A dependent lane that never saw a sibling's content goes stale ('overlapping files') during consolidation. Recovery is a manual merge, conflict resolution and `merge --resume`.

move-task --to approved requires every subtask marked done and a verdict for every #NNN (including cross-refs). deferred-with-followup requires a handle, and review-cycle bookkeeping must be committed between WPs.
The integration suite on the merged tree caught 3 real cross-WP regressions that per-WP reviews and the pre-PR diff review missed.
suggested_fix: Always run the integration gate on the consolidated tree and classify reds against the merge base.

summary: Integration reds that were not the diff: test_org_cascade_chain was red on base, and test_lifted_root_no_checklist_surface failed only because of gitignored generated agent files in the working clone.
The ruff-format-exclude ratchet tripped, and a foundation-forward helper needed a dead-module allowlist entry that later WPs removed (bidirectional ratchet).
The pre-implement brownfield scout caught 4 traps before dispatch, including a charter->specify_cli layer violation and a test that would break.
The composite (id, kind) sort key and the _recompile_catalog_best_effort UnknownArtifactIdError residual were deferred as PR-body fast-follows.
Charter write commands now fail closed from linked worktrees (DD-05); this is the origin of the linked-worktree test reds other missions hit.
The Bash cwd resets to the primary repo between calls, so every command must cd into the shadow clone.
The clone's main was 353 commits behind canonical, and its `upstream` remote pointed at the pre-move Priivacy-ai line; `skupstream` had to be added.
About 9 forked dirty-check predicates with no canonical owner were found, so the fix unified one refuse-before-destroy guard instead of patching 3 sites.
core/vcs/git.py remove_workspace is dead (zero callers). The plan assumed it was the chokepoint, and the WP was re-scoped to a new guarded_worktree_remove.
A hand-written gate allowlist was factually wrong (missing sites plus a phantom); the baseline must come from a live census.
suggested_fix: Derive allowlist baselines from a live census with inline rationale per site.

summary: `branch -D` was deferred as a distinct loss surface that needs an is-merged guard.
The 'Appended during implement' sections of all three tracers stay '_(to be filled per WP)_'.
spec-commit silently commits only recognized spec artifacts, so decision records and status.events.jsonl need a plain git commit.
issue-verdict writes to the coordination branch, so the matrix is not visible in the working checkout.
CLI invocations bump the version and recompute the hash in synthesis-manifest.yaml (installed-version drift), which had to be discarded to keep commits clean.
The installed CLI reports 4.0.0rc3 while pyproject says 4.0.0rc4.

A worktree is not an install: regenerate-graph and activate need PYTHONPATH plus SPEC_KITTY_PACKS_ROOT. test_regenerate_graph_check_is_byte_identical false-reds against the stale binary, and charter context / doctor doctrine are not valid activation checks.
suggested_fix: Verify activation via charter_activated_urns.

summary: WPs were implemented directly on the mission branch because the lane-worktree allocator was fragile in a cluttered checkout.
ruff caught a third latent f-string reference that a manual grep had missed; trust the linter for rename completeness.
The pre-existing baseline red test_birth_cutover[coord] and the org_cascade_chain failures needed a closeout ledger to verify against skupstream/main.
`git revert` cannot cross a lane-consolidation merge commit without -m, so transactional rollback was scoped to the pre-merge span. Direct-on-target rollback was deferred to #3897.
Local ruff 0.15.14 vs pinned 0.15.12 caused format-drift noise, and merge.py has pre-existing whole-file format drift.
suggested_fix: Verify with pinned whole-repo ruff format --check at closeout.

summary: The FR-011 queryable event for the unreachable bake fallback was not added (reusing pending_coord_reconcile would corrupt the doctor surface); a merge-summary line is used instead.
`charter context --action implement` fails with 'Global asset input changed' (multi-install version mosaic), so subagents fall back to agent profile show.
A skip-lanes completing mission must target a non-protected branch, and CliRunner needs monkeypatch.chdir because resolution seams fall back to process CWD.
The mission's new CLI flags broke the golden fixture test_help_pins_one_line_help_and_every_visible_flag (a behaviour-change golden-shard blind spot).
Completion regeneration needed SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC=1 to bypass the daemon boundary, so a 'sync' residue identifier still gates behaviour.
The pre-PR aggregate squad caught a HIGH cross-WP defect (coord rollback x primary-tree bake) that both per-WP reviews missed because the test mocked the bake out.
root_cause: Moving a commit to a different partition defeats a same-partition rollback guard
suggested_fix: Aggregate/integration review of composition seams; avoid mocking the partner seam.

summary: The merge precondition failed open on a WP absent from the snapshot; it now folds absent WPs into missing (fail-closed).
